entries.name: Hospital Escuela de Veterinaria, Facultad de Ciencias Veterinarias UBA (Hospital de Pequeños Animales)
entries.duty: Small-animal hospital open Monday to Friday 9:00-19:00. A surgical on-call service is mentioned but its hours are not published. Not a 24-hour emergency clinic.
entries.note: Page opened 2026-11-09. Says 'Guardia Quirurgica' exists among services but gives no hours; equine hospital has no on-call. fvet.uba.ar itself could not be fetched (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED).

duty_i18n.de: Kleintierklinik, geöffnet Mo–Fr 9–19 Uhr. Ein chirurgischer Bereitschaftsdienst wird erwähnt, seine Zeiten sind nicht veröffentlicht. Kein Notdienst rund um die Uhr.
duty_i18n.fr: Hôpital pour petits animaux ouvert du lundi au vendredi, 9 h–19 h. Un service de chirurgie de garde est mentionné, mais ses horaires ne sont pas publiés. Pas d’urgences 24 h/24.

entries.name: Área Pequeños Animales, Hospital de Sanidad Animal, FCV Universidad Nacional del Litoral
entries.duty: Regular hours Monday to Friday 10:00-12:00 and 14:00-17:00. Emergencies are attended outside these hours, including nights, weekends and holidays; call ahead.
entries.note: Source is a university news article dated 2015 (possibly outdated). Article: phones 420639 / 421037 int. 111-357 (8-17 h); emergencies int. 111-362; emergencies Mon-Fri 12-14 and 17-8, weekends and holidays; 'las 24 horas solo se atienden urgencias'. Not a plain '24 h' claim, so emergency_24h left false. Verify before relying.

duty_i18n.de: Sprechzeiten Mo–Fr 10–12 und 14–17 Uhr. Notfälle werden außerhalb dieser Zeiten versorgt, auch nachts, am Wochenende und an Feiertagen; bitte vorher anrufen.
duty_i18n.fr: Horaires habituels : lundi–vendredi 10 h–12 h et 14 h–17 h. Urgences prises en charge en dehors de ces horaires, y compris la nuit, le week-end et les jours fériés ; appelez avant de venir.

entries.name: SNITV — Servicio Nacional de Información Toxicológica Veterinaria (Facultad de Ciencias Veterinarias, UNCPBA)
entries.duty: Veterinary poison information service, weekdays 8:00-18:00. Not a 24-hour line.
entries.note: From the 2015 national RedArTox directory (opened 2026-11-09); SNITV's own page was not found via search. Phone and hours need re-verification.

duty_i18n.de: Giftinformationsdienst für Tiere, werktags 8–18 Uhr. Nicht rund um die Uhr erreichbar.
duty_i18n.fr: Service d’information toxicologique vétérinaire, en semaine 8 h–18 h. Pas de ligne 24 h/24.

notes: Partial run. WebFetch only opened URLs that appeared in search results (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED otherwise) and search returned almost no Argentine clinic own-sites. 61 clinics advertised as 24 h (CABA/GBA/La Plata) were found only on the aggregator veterinarias.com.ar/urgencias-24-hs.html, so none were added (aggregator may not be the sole source). Candidates still to confirm from their own sites: Centro Medico Veterinario Belgrano (Amenabar 2214), Veterinaria del Libertador, Centro Medico Veterinario Buenos Aires (Av. Boedo 840), Hospital Veterinario del Oeste, Hospivet (Martinez), HV Hospital Veterinario (Olivos), Hospital Veterinario Lanus/Temperley/Adrogue/Ezeiza, Sanatorio Veterinario Glew. Tupungato (Mendoza) has a voluntary 24 h on-call rota (published monthly at tupungato.gov.ar/veterinarias-turno/; page could not be opened). Cordoba municipal emergency veterinary hospital (Corrientes 3086) and Rosario Hospital Animal (Av. Francia 1900, 8-20 h, 24 h planned) are not 24 h yet. Bariloche: no emergency vet service reported (news 2026-02). Mar del Plata, Salta, Cordoba private clinics: nothing usable found.
